mapper.sql: c.id, c.kind, c.subject, c.area, c.standard_code, c.domain_id, c.thinking_type, to_jsonb(c.grades) AS grades, to_jsonb(c.semesters) AS semesters, c.notice_grade_band, c.text, c.record
mapper.select: SELECT version, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions FROM knowledge_dataset WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT , NULL::double precision AS similarity FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.kind = #{kind} AND c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT , NULL::double precision AS similarity FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.kind = 'SUBJECT_GUIDE' AND c.subject IN #{subject} ORDER BY c.subject, c.id

SELECT standard_code, content_id FROM knowledge_covers WHERE dataset_version = #{version} AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') AND standard_code IN #{code} ORDER BY standard_code, content_id

SELECT standard_code, thinking_type, reason FROM knowledge_fits WHERE dataset_version = #{version} AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') AND standard_code IN #{code} ORDER BY standard_code, thinking_type

WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.* FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.kind = 'STANDARD' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_standard_semester s WHERE s.dataset_version = #{version} AND s.standard_code = c.standard_code AND s.grade = #{grade} AND s.semester = #{semester}) ), matches AS ( SELECT e.standard_code AS code, e.kind AS matched_kind, e.id AS matched_id, e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) AS distance FROM eligible e WHERE e.embedding IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.standard_code AS code, c.kind, c.id, c.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) FROM eligible e JOIN knowledge_covers r ON r.dataset_version = #{version} AND r.standard_code = e.standard_code AND r.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(r.reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') JOIN knowledge_chunk c ON c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.id = r.content_id AND c.kind = 'CONTENT' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL ), scored AS ( SELECT *, greatest(0.0, least(1.0, 1.0 - distance)) AS similarity, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY greatest(0.0, least(1.0, 1.0 - distance)) DESC, matched_kind, matched_id) AS match_rank FROM matches WHERE distance BETWEEN -0.000001 AND 2.000001 AND greatest(0.0, least(1.0, 1.0 - distance)) >= #{minimum} ), ranked AS ( SELECT f.thinking_type, e.standard_code AS code, e.record->>'statement' AS statement, e.subject, e.area, s.similarity, s.matched_kind, s.matched_id, f.reason AS fit_reason, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.thinking_type ORDER BY s.similarity DESC, e.standard_code) AS type_rank FROM scored s JOIN eligible e ON e.standard_code = s.code LEFT JOIN knowledge_fits f ON f.dataset_version = #{version} AND f.standard_code = s.code AND f.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(f.reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') WHERE s.match_rank = 1 ) SELECT thinking_type, code, statement, subject, area, similarity, matched_kind, matched_id, fit_reason FROM ranked WHERE type_rank <= #{k} ORDER BY thinking_type, similarity DESC, code

WITH scored AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.*, c.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) AS distance FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.kind = 'CONTENT' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL ) SELECT , greatest(0.0, least(1.0, 1.0 - c.distance)) AS similarity FROM scored c WHERE c.distance BETWEEN -0.000001 AND 2.000001 AND greatest(0.0, least(1.0, 1.0 - c.distance)) >= #{minimum} ORDER BY similarity DESC, c.id LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE standards(code) AS ( SELECT standard_code FROM knowledge_covers WHERE dataset_version = #{version} AND content_id = #{contentId} AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') UNION SELECT p.prerequisite_code FROM standards s JOIN knowledge_prerequisite p ON p.dataset_version = #{version} AND p.standard_code = s.code WHERE p.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') ) SELECT DISTINCT s.code AS standard_code, m.semester FROM standards s JOIN knowledge_covers c ON c.dataset_version = #{version} AND c.standard_code = s.code AND c.content_id = #{contentId} AND c.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND btrim(c.reviewed_by) NOT IN ('', 'SAMPLE') JOIN knowledge_standard_semester m ON m.dataset_version = #{version} AND m.standard_code = s.code ORDER BY m.semester, s.code
